messages:
zoe: heads-up — noticed a cluster of reseller tenants (reseller orgs) with a ~3x spike in preview quota used starting 02:00 UTC. not seen in production invoices yet.

mira: can you share an example tenant id and preview rows?

zoe: tenant=res-rx42 sample preview extract: 
- hour=2026-03-22T02:00Z route=web-infer sampling_weight=0.1 reported_tokens=1200
- hour=2026-03-22T02:00Z route=edge-infer sampling_weight=1.0 reported_tokens=3600

zoe: looks like the web-infer sampled at 10% but later aggregation multiplied instead of treating as sampled.

sam: hypothesis: sampling applied at the edge proxy emits a sample_rate field, but the preview aggregator expected sampling to be normalized upstream and doubled because it applied invert_sampling again. i.e. event.tokens *= 1/sample_rate at both edge and aggregator.

devon: that would yield overcount by 1/sample_rate factor. any logs showing transform behavior?

mira: grep shows edge-emitter v2 adds sample_rate tag and leaves tokens unscaled, while preview-agg v1 multiplies tokens by 1/sample_rate. however billing-ingest transform v3 also does scaling for historical reasons when sample_rate present. so triple scaling possible if versions differ.

sam: oof. how widespread is v2 vs v3?

zoe: canary map: edge-emitter v2 on 40% hosts, billing-ingest v3 on 80% of consumers, preview-agg still v1 on some low-traffic shards. mismatch window between rollouts.

mira: immediate mitigation: add a defensive check in preview-agg to ignore sample scaling if event.meta.sample_normalized=true. quick patch: if event.meta.sample_normalized: skip scaling.

devon: and ensure edge-emitter sets sample_normalized when it scales tokens. which currently it does not. so patch edge-emitter to set the flag if it scales.

sam: also emit telemetry: billing.sampling_mismatch_count and billing.sampling_overcount_factor histogram by route and tenant_type (reseller vs direct).

zoe: we should also run a recon job to compute corrected tokens = raw_reported_tokens / observed_scaling_factor and compare to invoices. propose a backfill-recon run for last 12 hours for reseller orgs only.

mira: agree. backfill plan: 1) generate candidate corrected aggregates (staging) 2) diff vs preview 3) create audit table for finance review 4) if approved, push corrected preview and mark notes. 3-day hold before touching invoices.

sam: engineering plan: ENG-4200 (edge-emitter sample flag), ENG-4201 (preview-agg defensive skip), ENG-4202 (telemetry counters), ENG-4203 (reseller-recon-backfill). I'll start ENG-4201 now for a hotfix.

devon: small safety: set preview-alert rule to page on tenant_preview_delta_pct > 200% within 1h for tenants with reseller tag. reduce noise threshold during backfill window.

zoe: pinging @billing-bot to create a finance note so they don't act on preview numbers until we finish reconciles.

billing-bot: note created: INC-2042-reseller-preview-sampling-overcount. finance and support notified.

mira: add also a dashboard card in the billing console: sampling_version drift by host and route, visible to infra owners. helps avoid silent rollouts.

sam: agreed. long-term we should centralize sampling to a single component (edge or ingest) and treat sample_rate as immutable; all other components must honor sample_normalized flag. adding to roadmap.

devon: can we add a small smoke test that emits a known sample_rate event and validates final invoice preview equals scaled value? if preview infra fails test, fail rollout.

zoe: will run the recon dry-run in staging and post diff SQL here. thanks team. :thumbsup:
